description: Posts a message into a room's stream as the assistant, where everyone in the room will see it. Use it when a user asks you to share something with a room, or when a routine's instruction says to deliver its result to a room other than the one the routine already posts in. Write for the room, not for the person who asked: say what it is and why it's here in the first line. To get someone's attention, write @ and their name as rooms_list shows it; they're told even if they only hear mentions. May return needs_confirmation; summarize the post and wait for approval.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation envelope.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: rooms_post
title: Post into a room
